chapter: CBS, return to Ellington and retirement
title: Recordings during the CBS years
summary: He recorded mostly jazz sessions with Gleason and others but remembers few names.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: And you said during that time you did do some recording. Who did you record (with) during that period?
Well, Gleason, and then a few outside records when you could fit them in your program.

Now, that -- I don't recall too many of the names. You just go make a recording session and you never worry. You just forget it, yeah. Pick up the check down at the union a couple of weeks later, and that's it.
Well, those recordings are very important to your following, even if you do forget them right away.
so I wondered if you remembered any of the records you were on.
Some of them I've never heard, but some of them -- I'd hear them and then forget them. See, by
moving around so much when I went back to the big band, I couldn't carry all that recording stuff with me, so I'd just leave it and lose it and things like that.
And after four years on CBS staff -- that would be what? About 1960 then?
